title: Current LDAP Identity continuation baseline

baseline.version_note: dev23 unifies the activation/revocation rehearsal and the owned persistent LDAPS/systemd deployment boundary.

current_work: Rasen Falcon now has an owned persistent LDAP service bootstrap over IdentityDirectory, NoSQLDirectoryStore, Secret Broker and mandatory TLS.
The production daemon fails closed unless durable state already contains ACTIVE resource:directory and required secret/TLS references are available.
A hardened non-root rasenfalcon-ldap.service is supplied; startup does not provision identities, ACLs or credentials.
The pre-install rehearsal covers principal isolation, revoked-principal denial, native wire listener, restart recovery, STARTTLS/LDAPS and Access Permissions.
Website, SMTP, IMAP and MCP consume the same directory truth with explicit per-action authority; Bind and signing do not imply EMAIL_SEND.
